answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 39169 Country: United States of America Title: My mother-in-law passed away her husband is alive and has three daughters no son. Her brother and sisters have passed away too Question: My mother-in-law passed away her husband is alive and has three daughters no son. Her brother and sisters have passed away too. How do we distribute her wealth please advise us to distribute her remaining. Her brother’s son and two daughters are alive are they entitled to get anything too? Please, make dua for her maghfirah. Answer ID: 39169 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1290/1046/B=1433) In the question mentioned above, the inheritance of your mother-in-law shall be divided into 36 shares, out of which her husband shall get one forth i.e. 9 shares, and all the three daughters shall get two third i.e. 24 shares while remaining 3 shares shall go to the bhatija being as asaba (kinsman) and bhatiji shall get nothing. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Details: Husband: 1x09 = 09 Daughters: 3x08 = 24 Bhatija: 1x03 = 03 Total: 36 shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
